name: intraday_range_reversion_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus
thesis: When a stock touches its intraday high or low and immediately reverses on a specific bar pattern (pin bar / hammer at the extreme), it signals that the intraday range boundary has been defended. The intraday high/low acts as a natural support/resistance because algorithmic stop-placement and limit-order clustering occur at round extremes. The inefficiency arises because once an intraday extreme is established, many trailing stops and limit orders cluster just beyond it — when these are not triggered (false breakout), the snap-back into the range is aggressive. The edge persists because identifying 'defended range boundaries' in real-time requires pattern recognition beyond simple price comparison.

long.confirmation: next bar closes above current bar's high (confirmation of bounce)

conditions: (high - close) / (high - low) > 0.7 (inverted pin bar / shooting star)
short.confirmation: next bar closes below current bar's low (confirmation of rejection)

entry.entry_price: market order on confirmation bar close

exit.target: 50% of intraday range toward the midpoint: (session_high + session_low) / 2
exit.stop_loss: 0.15% beyond the session extreme (beyond session low for longs, beyond session high for shorts)
exit.trailing_stop: trail at 0.1% once 40% of target reached
exit.signal_exit: exit if session extreme is breached on elevated volume (genuine breakout)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX between 14-22; too low = no range, too high = range breaks easily
filters.time_filter: no entries before 10:00 (let range establish) or after 14:45
filters.volume_filter: volume on pin bar > SMA(volume, 20) (volume at the extreme is essential)
filters.trend_filter: prefer longs when price is above VWAP session midpoint (bullish bias)
filters.event_filter: skip on event days where range expansion is expected (RBI, budget)
other_filters: range must be established for at least 60 bars (1 hour) before signal is valid

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — range reversion with pin bar confirmation is pattern-dependent and hard to automate naively

weaknesses: On genuine breakout days, the first touch of the session extreme IS the breakout — strategy catches the wrong side
Pin bar recognition on 1-min bars is noisy; the pattern is more reliable on 5-min or 15-min bars
The 50% range reversion target is ambitious — many reversions stall at 20-30% of range
prior_art: Intraday range trading is classic (Toby Crabel, 'Day Trading with Short Term Price Patterns'). Pin bar / hammer patterns at range extremes are standard price action (Steve Nison, 'Japanese Candlestick Charting'). The combination of range boundary + candlestick pattern is well-practiced but hard to automate cleanly.
notes: Edge math: 0.58 * 40bps - 0.42 * 31bps = 23.2 - 13.0 = 10.2 bps gross. Costs ~11 bps. Net ≈ -0.8 bps. Marginally negative. Improvement: reduce target to 30% of range (more achievable, higher win rate) or use 5-min bar pin bars for higher-quality patterns.
